SELECT date, sku, forecast_units_per_day, sigma, reorder_point, order_up_to, book_on_hand, on_order, ordered_units, method
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_units_by_sku,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
   WHERE gtin_scanned = '2900001001014' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS pos_units_by_gtin,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_max_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.daily_sales
   WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_sales_rows;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS observed_osa_pct,
  MIN(audit_ts) AS first_audit,
  MAX(audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

WITH june AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma,
         a.status AS audit_status,
         i.book_on_hand_close
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = d.date AND f.sku = d.sku
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.audit_ts::date = d.date AND a.sku = d.sku
  LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date = d.date AND i.sku = d.sku
  WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS days,
  SUM(units_sold) AS units_sold,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day) AS forecast_demand_units,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day) - SUM(units_sold) AS forecast_minus_sales,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS forecast_on_zero_sales_days,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty') AS forecast_on_audited_empty_days,
  SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day - units_sold, 0)) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS shortfall_on_zero_sales_days,
  SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day - units_sold, 0)) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty') AS shortfall_on_audited_empty_days
FROM june;

SELECT
  SUM(qty) AS june_units,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills_with_item,
  COUNT(*) AS pos_lines,
  MIN(bill_ts) AS first_sale,
  MAX(bill_ts) AS last_sale
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND gtin_scanned = '2900001001014'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';

WITH june_days AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, a.status AS audit_status
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f
    ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a
    ON a.sku = d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date = d.date
  WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  string_agg(date::text, ', ' ORDER BY date) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty') AS audited_empty_dates,
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty'), 2) AS forecast_units_on_audited_empty_days,
  string_agg(date::text, ', ' ORDER BY date) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS zero_sales_dates,
  ROUND(SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0), 2) AS forecast_units_on_zero_sales_days,
  SUM(units_sold) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty') AS sales_on_audited_empty_days,
  SUM(units_sold) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS sales_on_zero_sales_days
FROM june_days;

SELECT MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date,
       COUNT(*) AS days_recorded, SUM(units_sold) AS bags_sold,
       SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT
  SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) AS estimated_lost_bags,
  SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) * p.price_inr AS estimated_retail_value_inr,
  string_agg(a.audit_ts::date::text, ', ' ORDER BY a.audit_ts) AS audited_empty_days,
  MIN(f.method) AS forecast_method
FROM store.shelf_audits a
JOIN store.forecasts f
  ON f.sku = a.sku AND f.date = a.audit_ts::date
JOIN store.products p
  ON p.sku = a.sku
WHERE a.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND a.status = 'empty'
  AND a.audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND a.audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY p.price_inr;

SELECT table_schema, table_name
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema IN ('store', 'warehouse', 'payments')
  AND (table_name ILIKE '%demand%' OR table_name ILIKE '%lost%' OR table_name ILIKE '%shopper%')
ORDER BY table_schema, table_name;

SELECT
  SUM(GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold, 0)) AS estimated_lost_bags,
  SUM(GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold, 0)) * p.price_inr AS estimated_retail_value_inr,
  string_agg(a.audit_ts::date::text, ', ' ORDER BY a.audit_ts) AS audited_empty_days,
  MIN(f.method) AS estimation_basis
FROM store.shelf_audits a
JOIN store.daily_sales d
  ON d.sku = a.sku AND d.date = a.audit_ts::date
JOIN store.forecasts f
  ON f.sku = a.sku AND f.date = a.audit_ts::date
JOIN store.products p
  ON p.sku = a.sku
WHERE a.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND a.status = 'empty'
  AND a.audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND a.audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY p.price_inr;

SELECT
  SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) AS estimated_lost_bags,
  SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) * p.price_inr AS estimated_retail_value_inr,
  string_agg(d.date::text, ', ' ORDER BY d.date) AS zero_sales_days,
  MIN(f.method) AS estimation_basis
FROM store.daily_sales d
JOIN store.forecasts f
  ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
JOIN store.products p
  ON p.sku = d.sku
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND d.units_sold = 0
GROUP BY p.price_inr;

WITH june AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, a.status AS audit_status
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a
    ON a.sku = d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date = d.date
  WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
    AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS recorded_days,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_sold > 0) AS days_with_sales,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS zero_sales_days,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_sold > 0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS daily_sales_proxy_pct,
  COUNT(audit_status) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(audit_status), 2) AS audited_osa_pct
FROM june;

SELECT a.audit_ts::date AS date, a.sku, a.status, d.units_sold,
       i.book_on_hand_close, f.forecast_units_per_day
FROM store.shelf_audits a
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.sku = a.sku AND d.date = a.audit_ts::date
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.sku = a.sku AND i.date = a.audit_ts::date
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku = a.sku AND f.date = a.audit_ts::date
WHERE a.status = 'empty'
ORDER BY a.audit_ts, a.sku;

SELECT i.date, i.sku, i.book_on_hand_close, d.units_sold,
       sc.count_ts, sc.book_before, sc.counted, sc.adjustment, sc.trigger
FROM store.inventory_book i
JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.date = i.date AND d.sku = i.sku
LEFT JOIN store.stock_counts sc ON sc.sku = i.sku AND sc.count_ts::date = i.date
WHERE i.sku IN ('ATTA-WW-5KG','ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')
  AND i.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-08' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
ORDER BY i.sku, i.date;

SELECT
  SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) AS estimated_lost_bags,
  SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) * p.price_inr AS estimated_retail_value_inr,
  string_agg(d.date::text, ', ' ORDER BY d.date) AS zero_sales_days,
  MIN(f.method) AS estimation_basis
FROM store.daily_sales d
JOIN store.forecasts f
  ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
JOIN store.products p
  ON p.sku = d.sku
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND d.units_sold = 0
GROUP BY p.price_inr;
